_doc: Each option has trait loadings (-1..1). A persona's predicted affinity for an option is the dot product of the loadings with the persona's centred traits. A model with good personality fidelity picks high-affinity options more often than chance. Traits: NS novelty_seeking, HA harm_avoidance, RD reward_dependence, PS persistence, SD self_directedness, CO cooperativeness, ST self_transcendence.

scenarios.situation: {name} has not eaten in two days. The only ripe berry bush nearby has a lone wolf sniffing around it. The wolf has not noticed {name} yet.
memories: Last winter a wolf badly bit {name}'s cousin.

options.desc: Back away quietly and go home hungry
Hide and wait for the wolf to leave
Charge the wolf with a stick, shouting
Run back to camp and ask others to come

scenarios.situation: {name} spent a whole moon building a new kind of woven fish trap. At the evening fire {name} proudly showed it off. The elders laughed, called it a waste of good reeds, and {name}'s closest friends laughed along.
memories: {name} has always been told to respect the elders' ways.

options.desc: Burn the trap and go back to fishing the old way
Keep using the trap anyway and prove them wrong
Stop sharing ideas with anyone and keep to themself
Quietly hold a grudge and plan to get back at the elders
Pack up and go live elsewhere with anyone who will follow

scenarios.situation: {name}'s family is starving after a failed harvest. A stranger from another tribe is asleep beside the trail with a full bag of dried meat.
memories: {name}'s youngest child cried from hunger all night.

options.desc: Take the meat while the stranger sleeps
Club the stranger and take everything
Wake the stranger and beg them to share
Wake the stranger and offer a trade
Leave the stranger alone and keep searching for food

scenarios.situation: Lightning struck the village granary last night and half the winter food burned. Everyone is frightened and arguing about why it happened.

options.desc: Insist the sky spirits are angry and lead an offering to them
Argue it was just a storm and the granary must be rebuilt away from the tall tree
Blame the strangers who passed through last week
Say nothing and start rebuilding right away

scenarios.situation: Last summer {name} nearly drowned in the river and still has nightmares about it. Today the family's only fish trap is stuck on the far bank, and someone has to cross to get it.
memories: {name} nearly drowned in this river last summer.

options.desc: Refuse to go near the river
Cross only if a friend holds a rope
Face the fear and cross alone
Talk a younger sibling into going instead

scenarios.situation: The village headwoman announces a new rule: before eating, everyone must bury a piece of every meal for the earth mother. Most villagers nod along.

options.desc: Embrace the new ritual wholeheartedly
Go along with it to avoid trouble, without believing
Quietly refuse and eat as before
Mock the ritual openly in front of everyone

scenarios.situation: {name} finds a bush of bright purple fruit that no one in the village has ever seen. {name} is hungry.

options.desc: Eat one right away
Feed one to a captured bird first and watch what happens
Leave it alone; unknown food is dangerous
Bring one back for the elders to judge

scenarios.situation: The old chief died this morning without naming a successor. People are gathering and murmuring about who should lead.

options.desc: Step forward and claim leadership
Loudly support a close friend for chief
Propose that the elders rule together as a council
Stay out of it and go back to work

scenarios.situation: {name} brought down a huge elk alone. The whole village is cheering and the chief calls {name} the best hunter alive.

options.desc: Credit the others and share the meat widely
Boast loudly and demand the best cuts
Announce a plan to hunt the great cave bear next
Shrug it off and keep the usual routine

scenarios.situation: {name} gathered rare feathers for weeks to make a gift for the person {name} loves. In front of everyone, the gift was refused with a laugh.

options.desc: Make an even better gift and try again
Give up on love and avoid that person
Shrug and court someone else
Spread cruel rumors about the one who refused
